messages.text: I’m looking for a globe that is specific to the north and south poles, maybe a 360 degree

A globe with a full-swing meridian is exactly what you want — the ring that holds the globe lifts free of the base so you can tilt and rotate the sphere a full 360 degrees, letting you look straight down at the North or South Pole instead of being locked to a fixed tilt. The Eureka 16" Antique Ocean Globe with Full-Swing Metal Meridian has that feature, plus raised relief terrain and over 4,000 place names, on a desktop-size sphere bigger than the Franklin 12" you were just looking at.

Is this mainly for your own desk or study, or is it going somewhere like a classroom?

The Eureka 16" works great on a desk — it's larger than average desktop globes but still sized to sit comfortably on one, and that full-swing meridian means you can spin it to any angle to study the poles up close. You'll find it listed as "Eureka 16" Antique Ocean Globe with Full-Swing Metal Meridian" in search — add it to your cart from that page whenever you're ready.
